post.description:
Kelley Blue Book value for one vehicle: make, model, year, trim (slug from `trims`, or KBB vehicle_id), mileage and condition. Returns the selected trade-in or private-party value with its KBB range, all four condition values for both price types, typical mileage and the ZIP/edition the values are valid for.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

condition.description:
condition

Provider reference: allowed values ["fair", "good", "very_good", "excellent"]; default "good".

mileage.description:
Odometer miles.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 999999.

price_type.description:
price_type

Provider reference: allowed values ["trade_in", "private_party"]; default "trade_in".

trim.description: kbb.com trim slug such as le-sedan-4d (see `trims`.slug). Required unless vehicle_id is given.

vehicle_id.description:
KBB vehicle id from `trims`; overrides trim.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

zip.description: Market ZIP; KBB values vary by region. Defaults to the proxy's location. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

post.description:
Search kbb.com dealer and private-seller inventory for a make (optionally model and trim) within a radius of a US ZIP code, optionally filtered by year, price, maximum mileage, exterior colour and drivetrain. Returns one page of 25 listings with price, KBB Fair Purchase Price and deal rating, mileage, VIN, seller and distance, plus the total match count for pagination.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

drive_type.description:
Drivetrain group. kbb.com groups AWD and 4WD together, so awd and 4wd return the same listings (drive_type AWD4WD).

Provider reference: allowed values ["awd", "4wd", "fwd", "rwd"].

exterior_color.description:
kbb.com exterior colour group; matches the manufacturer colour names in `exterior_color` (e.g. white matches Snowflake White Pearl Mica).

Provider reference: allowed values ["beige", "black", "blue", "brown", "burgundy", "charcoal", "gold", "gray", "green", "off_white", "orange", "pink", "purple", "red", "silver", "tan", "turquoise", "white", "yellow"].

listing_type.description:
Inventory to search: used, new, certified pre-owned, or all three. Defaults to used.

Provider reference: allowed values ["used", "new", "certified", "all"]; default "used".

make.description: kbb.com make slug, e.g. toyota, honda, ford, mercedes-benz.

mileage_max.description:
Only listings with at most this many miles on the odometer (kbb.com maxMileage filter; any ceiling, not just the site's 10,000-mile steps).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 999999.

model.description: kbb.com model slug, e.g. camry, civic, f150, model-3. Powertrain variants are not separate models (Kona Electric is kona, Bolt EV is bolt); an unknown slug fails with not_found naming the make's valid slugs. Omit for all models of the make.

page.description:
Result page; 25 listings per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 40; default 1.

price_max.description:
Highest advertised price to include, in whole US dollars; must not be below price_min.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

price_min.description:
Lowest advertised price to include, in whole US dollars.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

radius_miles.description:
Search radius in miles; 0 means nationwide. KBB pads a market's results with remote 'virtual dealer' delivery listings whose distance is not the seller's; with a non-zero radius these are excluded (count may be below page_size while total_count still includes them).

Provider reference: allowed values ["0", "10", "25", "50", "75", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500"]; default 50.

sort.description:
Result order: relevance (KBB default), price_asc / price_desc by KBB derived price (advertised price plus fees, so advertised prices are only approximately ordered), mileage_asc, year_desc (newest model year first), distance_asc (nearest seller first), newest (most recently listed first).

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "price_asc", "price_desc", "mileage_asc", "year_desc", "distance_asc", "newest"]; default "relevance".

trim.description: Trim name as shown in listings (e.g. SE, XLE, Sport Touring). Requires model.

year_max.description:
Newest model year to include, inclusive; must not be below year_min.

Provider reference: minimum 1981; maximum 2030.

year_min.description:
Oldest model year to include, inclusive.

Provider reference: minimum 1981; maximum 2030.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code at the centre of the search. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints
